children.value: > Fact From Story: In a dramatic turn of events late Friday, ex-Y Combinator president Sam Altman was fired as CEO of AI startup OpenAI.
> > Fact From Story: “The board no longer has confidence in [Altman’s] ability to continue leading OpenAI,” the blog post reads.
> > Fact From Story: Altman’s “departure follows a deliberative review process by the board”.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO is the leader of a company.

> Fact From Story: Sam Altman has been fired from OpenAI, Inc., the 501(c)(3) nonprofit that acts as the governing body for OpenAI, the AI startup behind ChatGPT, DALL-E 3, GPT-4 and other highly capable generative AI systems.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Being fired means that someone is removed from their position of employment.
